A concrete candidate exists: BeamlineStatus is an ophyd Device at startup/10-optics.py:13 with four Component(EpicsSignalRO, ...) declarations at startup/10-optics.py:14-19, instantiated with an empty prefix at startup/10-optics.py:22. The reference resolves, and the fake gate reaches G1-G6 and G8; it cannot pass G7. Every fake value is a placeholder.

G7 blocker: startup/10-optics.py cannot be a legacy package.module:Class selector because the module token rejects the hyphen in the file name. The explicit selector pyfile:startup/10-optics.py#BeamlineStatus is accepted by the definition model and the reference generator, but G7 rejects it with G7.NOT_AN_ENTRY_SYMBOL ('an explicit source selector needs a confirmed card entry') because task.json has no entry_symbols. G7 also reports G7.NOT_UPSTREAM for 'shutter_status.get', 'beam_current.get', 'beamline_enabled.get' and 'cryo_filling.get': the explicit source surface counts only names declared in the class body, while get is inherited from EpicsSignalRO. A corrected card entry alone would therefore not be enough; the SDK needs a reviewed source-bound profile for inherited Signal reads, or a class in a legacy-importable module.

The card's OphydDriver helper cannot express this repository either: its source proof rejects startup/10-optics.py because EpicsSignalRO is also used through FormattedComponent in an unrelated class at startup/10-optics.py:133-134, and the startup file is not importable.
